name: knos_pay_v2
docs: Pay on proof, second deployment: an escrow that pays the author of a pull request on a GitHub-signed token verified on chain by knos-oidc.
Upgradeable only through a multisig with a public 48-hour delay, until an outside review.

A native program: this file is written by hand from programs-v2/knos_pay/src (lib.rs and order_terms.rs list every instruction, state.rs and order_terms.rs every account) and checked by tests/test_idl.py and tests/test_pay2_idl.py.
Instruction data is the discriminant byte, then the arguments in order, little-endian, with no padding. A `bytes` argument runs to the end of the data.
Every token account below is a VERIFIED GitHub Actions token account owned by knos-oidc (the second deployment's verifier), from a GitHub-hosted
runner, at most an hour past its expiry, issued no more than 300 seconds ahead of the chain's clock and living at most an hour.
The account after it, key, is knos-oidc's account of the key that verified the token (the token account names it at bytes 18..50). It must be usable now:
a token is refused from the moment its key is revoked or expires (errors 76 to 78), and works again once an expired key is refreshed. What each token must say is in its audience (the aud claim):
fund knos2:fund:<issue>:<amount units>:<mode 0|1>:<terms hash hex>:<work seconds>:<balance address>, from fund.yml, on an issue_comment or issues event, the run's first attempt;
pay knos2:pay:<repository id>:<issue>:<payee github id>:<head sha>:<terms hash hex>:<mode>:<address or ->, from the job's pinned prove.yml;
bind knos2:bind:<address>, from the pinned claim workflow, run by hand by the owner of a repository named knos-claim (workflow_dispatch only, first attempt; a push is refused).
The terms hash is sha256 of the terms JSON that the funding instruction carries and logs (knos2:terms <json>).
Anyone may relay FundBalance, Pay, Settle, Refund, Bind and FaucetOpen and pay their gas. tokenProgram is SPL Token or Token-2022, the owner of the mint.
2.1 adds work orders (instructions 12..27), whose audiences start knos3:, and four fixes to the 2.0 paths:
bounds and fee floors in whole units of the mint, a Token-2022 extension allow-list, a Balance's side account of limits, and single-use pay tokens.
An order's audiences: fund knos3:fund:<issue>:<amount units>:<mode>:<terms hash hex>:<work seconds>:<balance address>:<seq>:<opts hex>, from fund.yml;

pay knos3:pay:<order address>:<head sha>:<terms hash hex>:<mode>:<pr>:<payees>, from a judge; payees: 1..=4 of <github id>.<basis points>.<address or -> joined by `,`, the basis points adding up to 10000;
rule knos3:rule:<order address>:<payees>, the ruling of the arbiter the order named; bind knos3:bind:<address>, an organisation's wallet;
take knos3:take:<order address>:<taker github id>:<days>; cancel knos3:cancel:<order address>; revert knos3:revert:<order address>:<head sha>.
The judges of an order (who may sign its pay token), all from the workflows the order pinned at funding, on a run's first attempt: a. prove.yml run in the order's own repository;

b. for an order funded NEUTRAL and not PRIVATE, attest.yml started by hand (workflow_dispatch) by the owner of the repository it ran in; c. prove.yml or attest.yml run in the order's judge repository;
d. a ruling: attest.yml started by hand by the order's arbiter in a repository he owns. PayOrder also takes a token under a private key (knos-oidc's RegisterPrivateKey) for a PRIVATE order
of a Balance, when the wallet that registered the key is the wallet that opened that Balance; never for a ruling. Every other instruction takes only tokens a key of GitHub's verified.
A command about an order (Reserve, Cancel) is not a judge's: it is from the pinned fund.yml (the job that answers a comment) or prove.yml run in the order's own repository, a first attempt;
Reserve also takes attest.yml started by hand by the owner of the repository it ran in, for an order funded NEUTRAL and not PRIVATE. The judge repository and the arbiter sign no command.

e. for an order funded AUTO (mode 1 only): audience knos3:auto:..., the order's own prove.yml, which ran the pinned black-box suite on an open pull request's head; it pays that pull request's author unmerged. An order's QUORUM (2 or 3) is how many distinct judges of a, b, c must pass the same artifact before PayOrder pays.

instructions.name: OpenBalance
docs: A wallet opens a Balance for the repositories of one GitHub owner (a user or an organisation): its own money, spendable by GitHub-signed comments. No money moves; add money with a plain token transfer to baltok.

accounts.name: authority
accounts.desc: The wallet that owns the Balance; pays the rent

accounts.name: balance
accounts.desc: PDA ["bal", ownerId u64 LE, authority, mint]

accounts.name: baltok
accounts.desc: PDA ["baltok", balance]: the Balance's token account, created here

accounts.name: mint
accounts.desc: The mint; a Token-2022 mint must pass the extension rules

accounts.name: auth
accounts.desc: PDA ["auth"]: owner of every token account of the program

accounts.name: tokenProgram
accounts.desc: SPL Token or Token-2022: the mint's owner

instructions.name: SetBalance
docs: The wallet that opened a Balance sets its cap per job (0: none) and its four spenders (0: empty).

instructions.name: Withdraw
docs: The wallet that opened a Balance takes unspent money back, to a token account of its own. A faucet Balance cannot withdraw. Never paused.

accounts.name: destToken
accounts.desc: A token account of the Balance's mint owned by the authority

instructions.name: FundBalance
docs: One comment funds a job from the Balance its fund token names. The token is from a run in a repository of the Balance's owner, by the owner or a
listed spender (a faucet Balance: any actor), and works once: its iat must be later than the Balance's last, so a Balance takes its tokens in the order GitHub issued them.
The data is the terms JSON whose sha256 the audience carries (at most 600 bytes of printable ASCII). Refused while new funding is paused.
2.1: once the Balance has a side account (Balance.hasX) it is required after the others, PDA ["balx", balance], writable, and its limits are enforced.
The token's single-use marker `used` is the 13th account, and the side account then the 14th: no instruction takes the token again.

accounts.name: relayer
accounts.desc: Anyone; pays the job's rent and gets it back when the job closes

accounts.name: key
accounts.desc: knos-oidc's key account that verified the token: PDA ["key", issuer u8, sha256(modulus)] of knos-oidc

accounts.name: balance
accounts.desc: The Balance the token's audience names

accounts.name: job
accounts.desc: PDA ["job", repoId u64 LE, issue u64 LE, balance]

accounts.name: vault
accounts.desc: PDA ["vault", mint]: the mint's vault, created on first use

accounts.name: used
accounts.desc: PDA ["used", sha256(the token's signature bytes)]: the token's single-use marker, created here; a fund token works once

accounts.name: balx
accounts.desc: PDA ["balx", balance]: required once the Balance has a side account (hasX)

instructions.name: FundWallet
docs: A wallet funds a job with its own money, pinning the repository and commit of the prove.yml that can prove it. Refused while new funding is paused.

accounts.name: funder
accounts.desc: The funding wallet; pays the job's rent and gets it back when the job closes

accounts.name: job
accounts.desc: PDA ["job", repoId u64 LE, issue u64 LE, funder]

accounts.name: funderToken
accounts.desc: A token account of the mint the funder has authority over

accounts.name: vault
accounts.desc: PDA ["vault", mint], created on first use

accounts.name: mint
accounts.desc: The mint; a Token-2022 mint must pass the extension rules

instructions.name: Pay
docs: A pay token from the job's pinned prove.yml pays an open job: the fee to feeToken, the rest to a token account of the payee's bound wallet,
or with no Bind of the address in the audience. With neither, no money moves and the job is held for the payee for 180 days (the accounts
after bind are then not used). The payee's record is updated and the job is closed. There is no veto and no waiting time.
2.1: the token's single-use marker is the 16th account; a second job is refused with error 91.

accounts.name: relayer
accounts.desc: Anyone; pays the rent of the record accounts

accounts.name: key
accounts.desc: knos-oidc's key account that verified the token

accounts.name: bind
accounts.desc: PDA ["bind", payee id u64 LE] (it need not exist)

accounts.name: destToken
accounts.desc: A token account of the job's mint owned by the destination wallet

accounts.name: pair
accounts.desc: PDA ["pair", payee id u64 LE, funder key]: funder key is the funding wallet, or sha256("gh" || owner id u64 LE) for a Balance's job

accounts.name: feeToken
accounts.desc: A token account of the job's mint owned by the fee owner

accounts.name: rentTo
accounts.desc: The job's rentTo field: gets the job's rent back

accounts.name: used
accounts.desc: PDA ["used", sha256(the pay token's signature bytes)]: created here; a pay token pays, or holds, exactly one job

instructions.name: Settle
docs: Pays a held job, within its 180 days, once its payee has bound a wallet: to a token account of that wallet. No token is needed.

accounts.name: relayer
accounts.desc: Anyone; pays the rent of the record accounts

accounts.name: bind
accounts.desc: PDA ["bind", the job's payee id u64 LE]

accounts.name: destToken
accounts.desc: A token account of the job's mint owned by the bound wallet

accounts.name: pair
accounts.desc: PDA ["pair", payee id u64 LE, funder key]

accounts.name: feeToken
accounts.desc: A token account of the job's mint owned by the fee owner

instructions.name: Refund
docs: An open job past its deadline, or a held job past its hold: the money goes back where it came from and the job is closed. No token is needed.

accounts.name: refundToken
accounts.desc: The job's refundTo (a Balance's token account), or for a wallet's job a token account of the mint owned by refundTo

instructions.name: Bind
docs: Binds the address in a bind token's audience to the token's actor: where that GitHub user is paid. A Bind that exists is replaced only by a later token.

accounts.name: key
accounts.desc: knos-oidc's key account that verified the token

accounts.name: bind
accounts.desc: PDA ["bind", the token's actor id u64 LE]

accounts.name: used
accounts.desc: PDA ["used", sha256(the token's signature bytes)]: the token's single-use marker, created here; a bind token binds once

instructions.name: Pause
docs: The guardian refuses new funding (FundBalance, FundWallet) for at most 7 days from now; 0 lifts the pause. Nothing else can be paused.

accounts.name: payer
accounts.desc: Pays the pause account's rent the first time

instructions.name: InitFaucet
docs: Devnet builds only. Creates the test-USDC mint (SPL Token, 6 decimals); its mint authority is the program.

instructions.name: FaucetOpen
docs: Devnet builds only. Mints a fund token's amount of test USDC (at most 100) into the faucet Balance of the token's repository owner, created on
first use, and only when that is the Balance the token's audience names. One per repository per minute, in the order GitHub issued the tokens.
The token's marker is made here as MINTED: the funding instruction that then spends that Balance with it (FundBalance, FundOrderBalance) is the one thing that still takes it.

accounts.name: key
accounts.desc: knos-oidc's key account that verified the token

accounts.name: balance
accounts.desc: PDA ["bal", the token's repository owner id u64 LE, auth, faucet mint]: the Balance the token's audience names

accounts.name: rate
accounts.desc: PDA ["rate", the token's repository id u64 LE]

accounts.name: used
accounts.desc: PDA ["used", sha256(the token's signature bytes)]: the token's single-use marker, created here; made as MINTED (2): the faucet mints once on a token, and the funding that follows is the one instruction that still takes it

instructions.name: Version
docs: Logs `knos2:version 1`. Simulate it to learn whether 2.1 is live: 2.0 refuses the instruction.

instructions.name: SetBalanceX
docs: The wallet that opened a Balance sets its side account: limits per day (UTC) and in total, in the mint's smallest units (0: none); the only
repository ids that may spend it (all zero: any repository of the owner); the only commit of the pinned workflows that may spend it (all zero: any).
Created on first use; its counters stay. From then on every funding from the Balance must pass it and is held to it.

accounts.name: authority
accounts.desc: The wallet that opened the Balance

instructions.name: SetPlan
docs: FEE_OWNER sets the fee rate (10..=30 basis points; the standard rate is 30) of the orders funded from Balances of one repository owner, while now < expires.

accounts.name: payer
accounts.desc: Pays the Plan's rent on first use

instructions.name: FundOrderWallet
docs: A wallet funds a work order for an issue of any public repository: the amount its payees will receive plus the fee on top (0.30% of the amount, one rate and no tiers;
at least 0.05 of a whole unit of the mint; no maximum), into the order's own token account. opts (48 bytes): flags u8 (PRIVATE 2, NEUTRAL 4, STANDING 8), holdbackBps u16,

warrantyDays u16, killBps u16, reserveDays u8, rate u64, arbiterId u64, judgeRepoId u64, salted u8, grace u8 (1: a pay token issued by the deadline still pays for 7200 seconds after it, and RefundOrder waits as long), 14 zero bytes. A PRIVATE order: repoId and issue are 0
and terms is its scope (32 bytes) then the sha256 of its terms (32 bytes); otherwise terms is the terms JSON, which is logged. Refused while new funding is paused.

accounts.name: funder
accounts.desc: The funding wallet; pays the rents and gets them back

accounts.name: order
accounts.desc: PDA ["ord", scope, funder, seq u32 LE]; scope is sha256("knos3:scope" || repoId u64 LE || issue u64 LE)

accounts.name: funderToken
accounts.desc: A token account the funder has authority over

instructions.name: FundOrderBalance
docs: One comment funds a work order from the Balance its fund token names (audience knos3:fund:<issue>:<amount>:<mode>:<terms hex>:<work>:<balance>:<seq>:<opts hex>).
The token is checked as FundBalance checks it and works once: its marker is created here. The amount plus the fee (at the owner's Plan rate) leaves the Balance;
the Balance's cap and its side account's limits are enforced. The data is the terms JSON whose sha256 the audience carries.
A PRIVATE order: the data is its scope (32 bytes) then the sha256 of its terms (32 bytes); the audience carries issue 0 and, as terms, sha256 of those 64 bytes;
the token is from fund.yml in the order's judge repository. The order stores no repository and no issue, and no terms are logged. An arbiter cannot be the funding commenter or the Balance's owner.

accounts.name: relayer
accounts.desc: Anyone; pays the rents and gets the order's back

accounts.name: key
accounts.desc: knos-oidc's key account that verified the token

accounts.name: plan
accounts.desc: PDA ["plan", the Balance's owner id u64 LE] (it need not exist)

accounts.name: order
accounts.desc: PDA ["ord", scope, balance, seq u32 LE]

accounts.name: used
accounts.desc: PDA ["used", sha256(the fund token's signature bytes)]: created here

instructions.name: PayOrder
docs: A pay token of one of the order's judges (audience knos3:pay:<order>:<head sha>:<terms hex>:<mode>:<pr>:<payees>) pays an open order to 1..=4 payees.
The last five accounts are the first payee's; for each further payee of the audience, in its order, five more follow: bind, wallet, destToken (writable), rep (writable), pair (writable).
Each payee receives its share of the amount, whole; of the fee, the tip (0.05, or 0.30 when a payee's token account was created here) goes to tipToken and
the rest to feeToken. One payee with no address and no Bind: the order is held for it. The token is any judge's of the order (a, b, c, or the arbiter's ruling, audience knos3:rule:<order>:<payees>).

After the payees' accounts comes one assign account per payee, in the payees' order: PDA ["as", order, payee id u64 LE]; it need not exist but cannot be left out, and a payee who assigned this order's payment (Assign) is paid at the wallet it names.
Then one more account, writable: PDA ["done", order, pr u64 LE] for a STANDING order (created here: the order pays its rate once per pull request), or PDA ["hb", order] for an order with a holdback
(created here: the holdback stays in the order, which is in warranty until now + warrantyS). On such orders every payee needs a wallet now; an order that is both is refused (Later).

An order funded AUTO (flags 32; only with mode 1, the black-box acceptance suite) also takes audience knos3:auto:<order>:<head sha>:<terms hex>:1:<pr>:<payee> from its own repository's pinned prove.yml (judge e):

the suite passed on the head of an open pull request, and its one author is paid with no merge. The first such token closes the order; while the order is reserved only its taker is paid this way. An order without AUTO refuses it (Claims).
An order with a QUORUM (flags >> 6 is 2 or 3) takes three more accounts, last and writable: PDA ["q", order, 0], PDA ["q", order, 1], PDA ["q", order, 2]. It pays when that many distinct judges

(0 the order's own repository, 1 a neutral run, 2 the judge repository) have passed the same audience after the order's address; each judge before the last writes its marker and nothing is paid. Two tokens of one kind count once. A ruling pays without a quorum.

accounts.name: relayer
accounts.desc: Anyone; pays the rent of the record accounts and of token accounts created here

accounts.name: key
accounts.desc: knos-oidc's key account that verified the token

accounts.name: ov
accounts.desc: PDA ["ov", order]: the order's own token account

accounts.name: tipToken
accounts.desc: A token account of the order's mint owned by the relayer: receives the tip

accounts.name: feeToken
accounts.desc: A token account of the order's mint owned by FEE_OWNER: receives the rest of the fee

accounts.name: rentTo
accounts.desc: The order's rentTo: gets the rent of the order and of its token account back

accounts.name: used
accounts.desc: PDA ["used", sha256(the token's signature bytes)]: the token's single-use marker, created here; a pay token or a ruling pays, or holds, once

accounts.name: bind
accounts.desc: The first payee's: PDA ["bind", payee id u64 LE] (it need not exist)

accounts.name: wallet
accounts.desc: The wallet that payee is paid at: its assignee for this order, else the address the token carries for it, else its Bind's

accounts.name: destToken
accounts.desc: A token account of the order's mint owned by that wallet; created here as its associated token account when it does not exist

accounts.name: pair
accounts.desc: PDA ["pair", payee id u64 LE, funder key]

accounts.name: assign
accounts.desc: The first payee's: PDA ["as", order, payee id u64 LE] (it need not exist); one per payee, after all the payees' accounts

accounts.name: doneOrHb
accounts.desc: A STANDING order: PDA ["done", order, pr u64 LE]. An order with a holdback: PDA ["hb", order]. Created here. Any other order: left out

instructions.name: Release
docs: After the warranty of an order with a holdback (state warranty, now past holdUntil), anyone: each wallet the record PDA ["hb", order] names receives its part of the holdback, whole;
the tip (0.05, or 0.30 when a token account was created here) goes to tipToken and everything left (the rest of the fee) to feeToken. The order, its token account and the record are closed.

The last two accounts are the first recorded payee's; two more follow for each further payee of the record, in its order: wallet, destToken (writable). No token is needed. The record (Rep) is not updated.

accounts.name: relayer
accounts.desc: Anyone; pays the rent of token accounts created here and takes the tip

accounts.name: ov
accounts.desc: PDA ["ov", order]: the order's own token account

accounts.name: hb
accounts.desc: PDA ["hb", order]: the record of the holdback; closed here

accounts.name: tipToken
accounts.desc: A token account of the order's mint owned by the relayer: receives the tip

accounts.name: feeToken
accounts.desc: A token account of the order's mint owned by FEE_OWNER: receives what is left

accounts.name: rentTo
accounts.desc: The order's rentTo: gets the rent of the order and of its token account back

accounts.name: hbPayer
accounts.desc: Who paid the record's rent (its payer field): gets it back

accounts.name: wallet
accounts.desc: The first recorded payee's wallet, as the record stores it

accounts.name: destToken
accounts.desc: A token account of the order's mint owned by that wallet; created here as its associated token account when it does not exist

instructions.name: Revert
docs: Inside the warranty (state warranty, not past holdUntil), on a revert token: audience knos3:revert:<order>:<head sha>, from judge a, b or c of the order (as PayOrder's; never the arbiter's),

issued after the payment. Everything the order's token account holds (the holdback and the fee on it) goes back to where the order's money came from; the order, its token account and the record are closed.

This is also the challenge of a payment: for an order that allows a neutral run, anyone starts the pinned attest.yml by hand in a repository of his own, and its token returns the holdback inside the warranty. No bond is asked: the token is the pinned judge's own signed verdict.

accounts.name: relayer
accounts.desc: Anyone; pays the rent of the token's marker

accounts.name: key
accounts.desc: knos-oidc's key account that verified the token

accounts.name: ov
accounts.desc: PDA ["ov", order]: the order's own token account

accounts.name: hb
accounts.desc: PDA ["hb", order]: the record of the holdback; closed here

accounts.name: refundToken
accounts.desc: The Balance's token account (a Balance's order), or a token account of the order's mint owned by the funding wallet

accounts.name: rentTo
accounts.desc: The order's rentTo: gets the rent of the order and of its token account back

accounts.name: hbPayer
accounts.desc: Who paid the record's rent (its payer field): gets it back

accounts.name: used
accounts.desc: PDA ["used", sha256(the token's signature bytes)]: the token's single-use marker, created here; a revert token reverts once

instructions.name: Reserve
docs: Reserves an open order for the taker a take token names: audience knos3:take:<order>:<taker github id>:<days>, days 1..=the order's reserveDays.

The token is a command's: the pinned fund.yml or prove.yml run in the order's own repository, or (a NEUTRAL order) attest.yml started by hand in the taker's own repository; its actor_id is the taker it names: a person reserves for himself.
Refused on an order that is cancelled, past its deadline, or reserved now by someone. Sets reservedBy and reservedUntil = now + days. No money moves.

accounts.name: relayer
accounts.desc: Anyone; pays the rent of the token's marker

accounts.name: key
accounts.desc: knos-oidc's key account that verified the token

accounts.name: used
accounts.desc: PDA ["used", sha256(the token's signature bytes)]: the token's single-use marker, created here; a take token reserves once

instructions.name: Cancel
docs: The funder gives notice, once, on an open order: its deadline becomes min(deadline, now + 7 days) and cancelAt is set. A pay token still pays until then; after it RefundOrder returns the money,

less the kill fee when the order was reserved at the time. A wallet's order: the funding wallet signs. A Balance's order: anyone signs (writable: the signer pays the marker's rent) and the last four accounts carry a cancel token, the system program and the token's marker:
audience knos3:cancel:<order>, from the pinned fund.yml or prove.yml run in the order's own repository (a first attempt), whose actor funded the order or owns the Balance.

accounts.name: signer
accounts.desc: A wallet's order: the funding wallet. A Balance's order: anyone; pays the rent of the token's marker (only then must it be writable)

accounts.name: cancelToken
accounts.desc: A Balance's order: a VERIFIED cancel token

accounts.name: key
accounts.desc: A Balance's order: knos-oidc's key account that verified the token

accounts.name: used
accounts.desc: PDA ["used", sha256(the token's signature bytes)]: the token's single-use marker, created here; a cancel token cancels once; the signer pays its rent and must then be writable

instructions.name: RefundOrder
docs: An open order past its deadline, or a held one past its hold: everything its token account holds goes back to where its money came from. No token is needed.
When a kill fee is due (the order was cancelled while reserved: killBps of the amount, at most what is left of it) the last two accounts are passed: the fee goes to killToken first.

If the taker has no bound wallet, or killToken is not a token account of it, the fee stays in the order, held for the taker (SettleOrder pays him; after the hold it goes back), and the rest is refunded now.

accounts.name: refundToken
accounts.desc: The Balance's token account (a Balance's order), or a token account of the order's mint owned by the funding wallet

accounts.name: takerBind
accounts.desc: With a kill fee due: PDA ["bind", reservedBy u64 LE], the taker's (it need not exist)

accounts.name: killToken
accounts.desc: With a kill fee due: a token account of the order's mint owned by the taker's bound wallet

instructions.name: TopUp
docs: Adds to an open order's amount, and the fee on the new amount less the fee already there, from where its money came: the funding wallet signs, or the wallet
that opened the order's Balance signs and the Balance's token account pays. Refused while new funding is paused.

accounts.name: signer
accounts.desc: The funding wallet, or the wallet that opened the order's Balance

accounts.name: fromToken
accounts.desc: A token account of the funding wallet, or the Balance's token account

accounts.name: balance
accounts.desc: The order's source: its Balance (read), or the funding wallet (not read)

instructions.name: Assign
docs: A payee names the wallet that receives this order's payment in his place. The first time the payee's bound wallet signs; after that only the current assignee can change it,
so what was assigned cannot be taken back or assigned twice by the payee. PayOrder and SettleOrder then pay `to` for that payee. No money moves.

accounts.name: signer
accounts.desc: The payee's bound wallet, or the current assignee; pays the rent on first use

instructions.name: BindOrg
docs: Binds the address in an organisation's bind token (audience knos3:bind:<address>) to the token's repository owner: where that organisation is paid.
The token is from the pinned claim workflow, started by hand by a member in the organisation's repository named knos-claim (repository_owner_id is not actor_id).
It never replaces a Bind that Bind wrote; one that BindOrg wrote is replaced only by a later token.

accounts.name: bindToken
accounts.desc: A VERIFIED bind token of an organisation

accounts.name: key
accounts.desc: knos-oidc's key account that verified the token

accounts.name: bind
accounts.desc: PDA ["bind", the token's repository owner id u64 LE]

accounts.name: used
accounts.desc: PDA ["used", sha256(the token's signature bytes)]: the token's single-use marker, created here; a bind token binds once

instructions.name: SettleOrder
docs: A held order, not past its hold, whose payee now has a Bind: paid to that wallet (or to the wallet the payee assigned this order's payment to) as PayOrder pays. Anyone relays, and takes the tip.

accounts.name: ov
accounts.desc: PDA ["ov", order]: the order's own token account

accounts.name: tipToken
accounts.desc: A token account of the order's mint owned by the relayer: receives the tip

accounts.name: feeToken
accounts.desc: A token account of the order's mint owned by FEE_OWNER: receives the rest of the fee

accounts.name: rentTo
accounts.desc: The order's rentTo: gets the rent of the order and of its token account back

accounts.name: bind
accounts.desc: The first payee's: PDA ["bind", payee id u64 LE] (it need not exist)

accounts.name: wallet
accounts.desc: The wallet that payee is paid at: its assignee for this order, else the address the token carries for it, else its Bind's

accounts.name: destToken
accounts.desc: A token account of the order's mint owned by that wallet; created here as its associated token account when it does not exist

accounts.name: pair
accounts.desc: PDA ["pair", payee id u64 LE, funder key]

accounts.name: assign
accounts.desc: PDA ["as", order, the held payee's id u64 LE] (it need not exist): the wallet the payee assigned this order's payment to is paid

instructions.name: CloseMarker
docs: Anyone closes a marker that can no longer matter; its rent goes back to whoever paid it. A Used marker: after the time it stores (no token used when it was made can be accepted any more).
A Done marker: once the order it was made for is not at its order's address (the order was paid out or refunded, or one funded later is there). The kinds are told by their length.
A Q marker (122 bytes; 106 as 2.1 wrote it): once `order` is not the open order it was made for (closed, funded again later, or no longer open).

accounts.name: marker
accounts.desc: PDA ["used", ...] or PDA ["done", order, pr u64 LE] or PDA ["q", order, kind u8]

accounts.name: rentTo
accounts.desc: The marker's payer field: receives its rent

accounts.name: order
accounts.desc: A Done or Q marker: its order's address. A Used marker: not read

accounts.name: Balance
docs: PDA ["bal", ownerId u64 LE, authority, mint]: money a wallet set aside for bounties in the repositories of one GitHub owner. 160 bytes.
version is 1. faucet 1: the devnet faucet's Balance (its authority is the auth PDA; any actor spends it, nobody withdraws it).
capPerJob 0: no cap. spenders: GitHub ids that may spend it by comment besides the owner (0: empty). lastIat: the iat of the last fund token that spent it.
spent: everything it ever put into jobs.
hasX 1: it has a side account (BalX), which every funding from it must pass.

accounts.name: Job
docs: PDA ["job", repoId u64 LE, issue u64 LE, source]: one bounty. 320 bytes. source is the Balance it was funded from, or the funding wallet.
state: 1 open, 3 held (proven; waits for the payee to bind a wallet until holdUntil). mode: 0 merge, 1 tests. kind: 0 funded by a wallet, 1 from a Balance.
tokenProgram: 0 SPL Token, 1 Token-2022. faucet 1: the mint is the devnet faucet's (test money). amount: what the vault received.
payeeId: set when held. funderId: the GitHub id that wrote the funding comment (0 for a wallet). ownerId: the Balance's owner (0 for a wallet).
notBefore: a pay token must be issued at or after this. refundTo: the Balance's token account, or the funding wallet. rentTo: who paid the job's rent.
terms: sha256 of the terms JSON. wfRepoHash: sha256 of "owner/name" of the repository that holds the workflows. wfSha: their commit, 40 lowercase hex characters.

accounts.name: Bind
docs: PDA ["bind", userId u64 LE]: the wallet a GitHub user, or an organisation, is paid at. 56 bytes. version is 1. iat: the iat of the bind token that set it.
org 1 and orgIat equal to the low five bytes of iat: BindOrg wrote it as it stands (an organisation's). Bind leaves both as they are and writes a later iat, so a Bind a person made is never that.

accounts.name: Rep
docs: PDA ["rep", userId u64 LE]: a GitHub user's public record. 64 bytes.
paid, total: payments in real money from someone else, and what they put in the user's wallet. funders: distinct funders among them.
testPaid, testTotal: payments in the devnet faucet's test USDC. selfPaid: payments whose funder was the payee.
first, last: the time of the first and of the latest payment counted in paid (0: none yet).

accounts.name: Pair
docs: PDA ["pair", payeeId u64 LE, funder key]: exists (1) once this funder has paid this payee in real money. 1 byte.

accounts.name: Pause
docs: PDA ["pause"]: new funding is refused until this time. 8 bytes.

accounts.name: Rate
docs: PDA ["rate", repoId u64 LE]: the devnet faucet's last use by a repository, and that fund token's iat. 16 bytes.

accounts.name: BalX
docs: PDA ["balx", balance]: a Balance's side account, set by its authority (SetBalanceX). 152 bytes. version is 1. Limits in the mint's smallest units (0: none).
repos: the only repository ids that may spend the Balance (all zero: any of the owner). wfSha: the only workflows commit that may spend it (all zero: any).
day: unix time / 86400 of the day daySpent counts.

accounts.name: Plan
docs: PDA ["plan", ownerId u64 LE]: the fee rate of one repository owner's orders while now < expires, set by FEE_OWNER. 24 bytes. version is 1.

accounts.name: Used
docs: PDA ["used", sha256(a token's signature bytes)]: exists once an instruction took that token; every instruction that takes a token makes it and refuses a token whose marker exists (error 91). 41 bytes. used is 1; or 2 after the devnet faucet minted on the token, which the funding that follows still takes and sets to 1.
payer: who paid its rent. after: from this time no instruction can accept that token any more, and CloseMarker gives the rent back to payer.

accounts.name: Order
docs: PDA ["ord", scope, source, seq u32 LE]: one work order. 512 bytes. version is 2. state: 1 open, 3 held, 4 warranty. mode: 0 merge, 1 tests. kind: 0 funded by a wallet, 1 from a Balance.

flags: FAUCET 1, PRIVATE 2, NEUTRAL 4, STANDING 8, TOKEN2022 16, AUTO 32 (paid unmerged by the black-box suite; only with mode 1), and in the two high bits QUORUM: flags >> 6 is 0, or the 2 or 3 distinct judges a payment needs. amount: what payees receive in total; fee: escrowed on top of it; paid: of the amount, so far.
A private order stores 0 in repoId and issue and a scope its funder computed. Its money is in the token account PDA ["ov", order].

holdbackBps, warrantyS: that share of a payment stays in the order through the warranty (holdUntil, state warranty), then Release pays it or Revert returns it. rate: what a STANDING order pays per pull request.

inc: the slot of the order's funding plus one (0: funded under 2.1): its incarnation, which every marker made for it carries. grace: 1 when it was funded with the presentation grace. feeBps: the rate fixed at funding (30, or a Plan's 10..=30; up to 250 on an order of 2.1).
reserveDays, reservedBy, reservedUntil: a reservation (Reserve). cancelAt: when Cancel was sent (0: never). killBps: the share a taker is owed when a reserved order is cancelled.
payeeId: set when held. arbiterId: the GitHub id whose ruling pays it (0: none). judgeRepoId: the repository id whose runs may judge it (0: none). feeBps: the fee rate fixed at funding.
notBefore: a token must be issued at or after this. refundTo: the Balance's token account, or the funding wallet. rentTo: who paid the rents. terms, wfRepoHash, wfSha: as a Job's.

accounts.name: Hb
docs: PDA ["hb", order]: where the holdback of an order in warranty goes. 240 bytes. version is 1. Created by PayOrder, closed with the order by Release or Revert.
n: how many of the four entries are used (1..=4). payer: who paid its rent and gets it back. until: the end of the warranty (the order's holdUntil).
Entry k: payeeId, the wallet that was paid and receives the holdback, and its part of the holdback (the parts add up to exactly what was kept).

accounts.name: Done
docs: PDA ["done", order, pr u64 LE]: exists once this standing order, as funded now, has paid this pull request. 73 bytes (65 as 2.1 wrote it, without stamp: such a marker counts for an order of 2.1 only). done is 1. payer: who paid its rent. order: its order. stamp: the stamp of the order it was made for (Order.inc negated; an order of 2.1: its notBefore); an order funded later at the same address ignores it, and CloseMarker closes it once that order is not there.

accounts.name: As
docs: PDA ["as", order, payeeId u64 LE]: the wallet this order pays for that payee instead of the payee's own (Assign). 88 bytes. version is 1.
since: the stamp of the order it was made for (Order.inc negated; an order of 2.1: its notBefore); an order funded later at the same address ignores it.

accounts.name: Q
docs: PDA ["q", order, kind u8]: judge `kind` (0 the order's own repository, 1 a neutral run, 2 the judge repository) passed an artifact for an order with a QUORUM (PayOrder). 122 bytes (106 as 2.1 wrote it, without ownerId and actorId: such a marker counts for nothing).

ownerId, actorId: the repository_owner_id and the actor_id of the judge's run. Judges whose runs were in repositories of one owner count once, and a neutral run counts only when its owner is not the order repository's owner and its actor did not start the run in the order's repository.

since: the stamp of the order it was made for (Order.inc negated; an order of 2.1: its notBefore); an order funded later at the same address ignores it. artifact: sha256 of the audience after the order's address (head sha, terms hash, mode, pull request, payees).
payer: who paid its rent and gets it back (CloseMarker) once its order is not the open order it was made for.

errors.name: Base64Url
errors.msg: knos-oidc's claims reader: not unpadded base64url

errors.name: Json
errors.msg: knos-oidc's claims reader: the claims are not a JSON object

errors.name: DuplicateClaim
errors.msg: knos-oidc's claims reader: a claim appears twice, under any spelling of its name

errors.name: Claim
errors.msg: knos-oidc's claims reader: a claim is missing or of the wrong type

errors.name: KeyNotActive
errors.msg: knos-oidc's key rule: the key that verified the token is not active yet

errors.name: KeyExpired
errors.msg: knos-oidc's key rule: the key that verified the token has expired; the token works again once the key is refreshed, while the token is fresh

errors.name: KeyRevoked
errors.msg: knos-oidc's key rule: the guardian revoked the key that verified the token; the token can do nothing

errors.name: Accounts
errors.msg: A wrong account, or a missing signature

errors.name: Terms
errors.msg: The amount, work time, mode, workflow commit, terms JSON or pause length is not allowed

errors.name: Job
errors.msg: The job exists already, or this account is not a job

errors.name: State
errors.msg: Wrong state or time for this instruction

errors.name: Token
errors.msg: The token is not verified by knos-oidc, not GitHub's, expired, or its times are not GitHub's

errors.name: Claims
errors.msg: The token's claims do not allow this

errors.name: Workflow
errors.msg: The token is not from the workflow this instruction needs

errors.name: Audience
errors.msg: The audience does not match

errors.name: Payee
errors.msg: Wrong destination, fee or refund account, or the payee has no bound wallet

errors.name: DevnetOnly
errors.msg: Devnet builds only

errors.name: RateLimit
errors.msg: The faucet gives one funding per repository per minute, in the order GitHub issued the tokens

errors.name: Replay
errors.msg: This token is not newer than the last one used here, or was used already, or this pull request was paid already: a token works once

errors.name: Spender
errors.msg: The token's repository owner or actor may not spend this Balance

errors.name: Cap
errors.msg: More than the Balance's cap per job

errors.name: Funds
errors.msg: The Balance does not hold that much

errors.name: Mint
errors.msg: The mint or the token program is not accepted

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: New funding is paused

errors.name: Guardian
errors.msg: Not the guardian

errors.name: Balance
errors.msg: The Balance exists already, is not a Balance, or the signer is not its authority

errors.name: Faucet
errors.msg: A faucet Balance cannot withdraw

errors.name: Limit
errors.msg: More than the Balance's limit for one day or in total

errors.name: Order
errors.msg: The order exists already, or this account is not an order

errors.name: Plan
errors.msg: Not FEE_OWNER, or a plan rate or expiry that is not allowed

errors.name: Later
errors.msg: An order that is both standing and has a holdback is never paid: its money goes back to its funder at the deadline
